cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: One Last Thing
cards.instruction: Keep someone present by discovering one more small task, question, or favor whenever departure seems near.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you go, test the window latch. Push the frame, please; looking at it tells us nothing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One moment. The curtain is moving. We haven't isolated the draught.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's the fan. The window's fine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Switch the fan off and repeat the test. Same pressure, please. We can't compare results if you rush this one.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 pressure-test correction and A5 controlled repetition turn B departure into an expert reason for one more task each time.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4 solution to demand another complete test rather than permitting departure.
